javascript.title: JavaScript Foundations
javascript.description: A practical beginner JavaScript course covering values, decisions, collections, functions, DOM interaction, events, JSON, promises, async-await, local fetch, resilient interface states, and a complete event explorer.
javascript.moreComingSoon: More JavaScript Foundations lessons are coming soon.

javascript-foundations-module-1-values-d.title: Values, Variables, and Decisions
javascript-foundations-module-1-values-d.description: Build a reliable mental model for JavaScript values and use expressions and conditions to turn event information into useful messages.
outcomes: Distinguish strings, numbers, booleans, null, and undefined.
Store values with const and let and name them clearly.
Build readable text with string methods and template literals.
Use comparisons, logical operators, and conditionals to choose behavior.
why: Builds confidence with values, variables, and decisions.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

javascript-foundations-module-2-collecti.title: Collections, Repetition, and Functions
javascript-foundations-module-2-collecti.description: Help learners organize related data, name reusable operations, and process collections with clear iteration patterns before moving into browser interaction.
outcomes: Create arrays, read indexed values, inspect length, and append items with push.
Model structured records with objects and combine objects inside arrays.
Define reusable functions with parameters and return values.
Use for...of, map, and filter to process collections.
Combine collections and functions in a cumulative Event List Planner.
why: Builds confidence with collections, repetition, and functions.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

javascript-foundations-module-3-browser-.title: Browser Interaction and Data
javascript-foundations-module-3-browser-.description: Connect JavaScript to browser behavior, user input, local JSON data, async control flow, and explicit interface states.
outcomes: Select, update, create, and append DOM elements.
Respond to clicks, form submissions, and changed controls.
Parse JSON and check broad data shape at boundaries.
Fetch local JSON and check response.ok before parsing.
why: Builds confidence with browser interaction and data.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

javascript-foundations-module-4-campus-e.title: Final Capstone: Campus Event Explorer
javascript-foundations-module-4-campus-e.description: Transfer the complete JavaScript Foundations skill set into one progressive, data-driven browser application.
outcomes: Model, load, filter, and render campus event data.
Organize behavior into focused functions with explicit inputs and outputs.
Respond to user controls with clear and accessible interface updates.
Handle loading, error, empty, and success states deliberately.
why: Builds confidence with final capstone: campus event explorer.
Prepares learners for the next skills in the course.

javascript-javascript-foundations-sectio.title: Module Project

javascript-javascript-foundations-sectio.title: DOM, Events, and Async Data
javascript-javascript-foundations-sectio.description: Learn select and update the dom, events, forms, and user input, json and data boundaries through focused examples and practice.
